character.description: A rugged science-fiction mercenary designed like premium mid-1990s PC and arcade game key art translated into readable sprite-era game production art
character.face: strong simple facial planes readable at reduced scale
character.costume: chunky practical sci-fi armour with utility straps, boots and restrained industrial detailing

style.name: premium-1990s-pc-arcade-game-art
style.description: Authentic mid-1990s PC and arcade action-game production art combining hand-painted key-art sensibility, sprite readability, chunky silhouettes and limited-era rendering discipline rather than modern glossy concept art
style.medium: painted and pixel-informed game production illustration
style.period: 1993-1998 PC, DOS, SNES, Mega Drive and arcade visual language
style.lighting: dramatic directional game-art lighting with clear value separation

continuity_locks: keep the hero silhouette and costume construction coherent
keep the visual language firmly mid-1990s rather than modern retro cosplay

shots.description: Side-on action-game scene in a battered industrial outpost: the mercenary advances through a wide gameplay lane while a mechanical enemy enters from the opposite side, with readable cover, hazard lights and chunky level geometry
shots.pose: dynamic side-on combat-ready movement with clear limb separation
shots.camera: mostly side-stage gameplay view with only mild perspective, not isometric and not modern over-the-shoulder
shots.background: industrial sci-fi outpost built from large readable 1990s game level shapes
shots.framing: full-body action composition with generous gameplay space around both opposing silhouettes
